messages:
Samir D: Idea: Bike-to-work week challenge next Mon-Fri? keep it fun, minutes ridden or commutes count. coffee prize on Friday. :biking_man:
Ava L: Nice! I can do that. Do we want a leaderboard or just participation?
Samir D: Leaning participation + optional leaderboard (shortest avg time, most rides). Low pressure. :)
Markus H: I'm in. Route options? flat riverside or hill climb? Prefer flat mornings.
Ava L: Could do two routes, tag your ride with #riverside or #uptown-hills on Strava. Or just post pics here.
Priya N: Safety first — helmet, lights, and we'll set a rainy-day indoor spin alternative. Also pinging weather-bot for week forecast: @weather-bot next week forecast downtown.
weather-bot: Forecast for 2026-05-11 to 2026-05-15: Mix of sun and light showers midweek. Carry a packable rain jacket on Wed.
Samir D: thanks @weather-bot. Also thinking a group roll-out Wednesday @8:10am from lobby for the riverside route.
Markus H: I can lead the riverside group. Pace: social, no drop. :v:
Priya N: I'll run a short safety checklist post tomorrow with recommended lights/reflectors. Also, any interest in a weekend "commuter tune-up" mini-workshop? saddle height, brake check, quick lubes.
Ava L: yes to workshop. I need help with a squeaky chain.
Samir D: tagging calendar-bot to make the recurring Reminders: @calendar-bot add event "Bike-to-Work Week: group roll" 2026-05-11 08:10 -> 08:50 recurring Mon-Fri
calendar-bot: Event created: "Bike-to-Work Week: group roll" — invites sent to Samir D, Ava L, Markus H, Priya N
Priya N: Quick poll: prize? :coffee: 5x coffee vouchers or a $50 local bike shop gift card? react :coffee: or :bike:
Markus H: :bike:
Ava L: :bike:
Samir D: :coffee: (I like coffee but both great)
Priya N: Looks like gift card wins by a hair. I'll arrange. Who's signing up? React with :biking_man: if you're doing at least 3 rides next week.
Ava L: :biking_man:
Markus H: :biking_man:
Priya N: :biking_man:
Samir D: :biking_man:
Samir D: Awesome. Will post a simple leaderboard template in the channel and some quick route maps. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
